trigger: A spell requires S, M, or both
cost: Free hand or applicable held focus for M
choices: Shield emblem for Cleric/Paladin and staff for Druid can satisfy ordinary material and somatic together. A somatic-only spell still requires a free hand.

trigger: Caster possesses a costly or consumed component
choices: Use the supplied reusable Sorcerer diamond (50 GP), or spend a supplied Paladin flask of Holy Water (25 GP). Revivify requires its own 300 GP diamond and a dead target.

trigger: Trained bearer dons or doffs the issued shield
choices: Select don/doff with hand, AC and grip effects.

build: Druid, Fighter, Paladin and anyone who acquires their weapon
trigger: Wielder attacks with quarterstaff or longsword
cost: Two free-to-use hands for larger die
choices: Choose d6/d8 for quarterstaff or d8/d10 for longsword.

rule_source: SRD 5.2 pp. 13–14, 215 Interacting with Things and Attack
trigger: A carried weapon or one on the ground is accessible
cost: Free object interaction once a turn or Utilize action
choices: Stow, draw, drop, retrieve; attacking with a weapon can also draw it.

rule_source: SRD 5.2 pp. 89–91 Weapon Proficiency and Mastery
choices: Pick up, wield, select, stow or drop the individual weapon. Use its own damage die and the wielder's actual mastery.

cost: One arrow per attack and two available hands
choices: Stow the melee weapon, draw the bow with the attack and spend one arrow.

trigger: Throwing a held or accessible dagger
choices: Aim at a creature or a guessed point and leave the dagger where it lands. Attack rolls use the wielder's melee ability.

rule_source: SRD 5.2 Weapon Mastery and Weapon Properties
trigger: A trained weapon scores a qualifying hit
cost: Depends on property and individual restrictions
choices: Resolve the actual wielded weapon, issuer, attack classification and wielder's learned mastery. Reachable properties are Sap, Vex, Slow and Cleave.

rule_source: SRD 5.2 pp. 89–91 Weapon Proficiency and individual class training
trigger: Attack with an issued or acquired weapon
choices: Use the wielder’s class and order and the actual weapon. Add PB to an attack only for a proficient wielder; training and weapon mastery are separate.
